description: This file defines the main controller class 'SugarController' for SuiteCRM, an extension of SugarCRM. It manages request processing, access control, mapping actions to methods/views/files, and rendering views. It includes methods for executing actions, handling exceptions, loading beans, and performing common tasks like save, delete, and list views.

classes.name: SugarController
classes.description: The main MVC controller class for SuiteCRM, handling request processing, action dispatching, view rendering, access control, and common CRUD operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the controller with module and request parameters, loads mappings, and sets up access.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Bootstraps the complete request handling process, including processing actions and rendering views.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Determines and executes the appropriate action method, manages access, and handles redirection.

methods.name: handle_action
methods.description: Invokes pre-, main-, and post- action methods in sequence.

methods.name: loadBean
methods.description: Loads the data bean for the current module and record.

methods.name: getActionFilename
methods.description: Maps an action to its filename, considering case sensitivity.

methods.name: blockFileAccess
methods.description: Checks access control map and blocks access if necessary.

methods.name: handleEntryPoint
methods.description: Handles special entry points for entry point registry.

methods.name: callLegacyCode
methods.description: Handles legacy module views, falling back to old style PHP files.

methods.name: handleActionMaps
methods.description: Loads custom action maps for file or view remapping.

methods.name: remapAction
methods.description: Remaps current action to another action if mapped.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Performs save operation on the bean.

methods.name: action_delete
methods.description: Performs delete operation on the bean.

methods.name: showException
methods.description: Displays exception details and stack trace.
